mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_key (user_id, key_value, name, created_at, active) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keyValue}, #{name}, NOW(), TRUE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM api_key WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM api_key WHERE key_value = #{keyValue} AND active = TRUE
mapper.update: UPDATE api_key SET active = FALSE WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE api_key SET last_used = NOW() WHERE key_value = #{keyValue}
